model_scope.instructions: Choose the smallest scientifically honest implementation that permits CPU comparison against the independent square-MZ Gaussian overlap and incoherent reference while retaining a conservative spatial/direction gate and existing tests.
criteria: Add explicit positive constant beam waist and mutual coherence 0..1 as scene/source properties; use transverse output-mode displacement (not raw BS2 hit distance), Gaussian field overlap and coherent/incoherent power mixture; keep unresolved for centroids beyond existing tolerance or unmatched directions; label as phenomenological CPU model.
Use raw BS2 hit distance as Gaussian shift and treat any two rays as fully detected even when spatial/direction gates fail.
Add only a display property without changing optical calculation.

validation_gate.instructions: Decide the immediate evidence threshold after code changes under occupied-PC constraints.
criteria: Require CPU tests against Claude's independent waist values, phase-independent gamma=0 sweep, per-channel energy conservation, invalid parameter rejection and no regression; leave Blender/physical gate closed.
Promote as a physically validated photonic network after CPU-only formula agreement.
Run Blender/GPU immediately despite user resource restriction.
